supplements.title: Glycyrrhizic Acid Alleviates Osimertinib-Induced Cutaneous Toxicity by Inhibiting Keratinocyte Apoptosis and Inflammation.
supplements.summary: Glycyrrhizic acid reduces skin damage from osimertinib, a lung cancer drug, by decreasing inflammation and cell death in mice.

supplements.title: Shenling Baizhu Powder Alleviated Lung Damage and Enhanced Immunoregulatory Activity in Mice with Non-Tuberculosis Mycobacterial Lung Disease.
supplements.summary: A traditional herbal powder called Shenling Baizhu Powder reduced lung damage and boosted immune function in mice with mycobacterial lung disease.

supplements.title: Dihydroartemisinin Induces Ferroptosis in Ovarian Cancer via STAT3/GPX4 Signaling Pathway.
supplements.summary: A drug called dihydroartemisinin kills ovarian cancer cells by triggering a specific type of cell death through a particular signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Mechanistic Topology of Notopterygium incisum Essential Oil against Rheumatoid Arthritis: Machine Learning-Guided CASP1 Screening and Nanoemulsion Evaluation.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified compounds in Notopterygium incisum essential oil that reduce rheumatoid arthritis inflammation and created a nanoemulsion to improve drug delivery.

supplements.title: LC/MS-Based Phytochemical Profiling and Immunomodulatory Evaluation of Three Medicinal Plants With Anticancer and Antibacterial Activities.
supplements.summary: Three medicinal plant extracts showed promise against breast cancer cells and antibiotic-resistant bacteria through antioxidant and immune-boosting compounds.

supplements.title: Early-Onset Colorectal Cancer: New Risk Factors or More of the Same at Earlier Ages?
supplements.summary: Colorectal cancer in people under 50 is increasing due to both new bacteria and rising obesity, poor diet, and inactivity in younger generations.

supplements.title: Effect of Bendiocarb Administration on Oxidative Stress and Caspase-3/Caspase-9/Bax/Bcl-2/p53 Mediated Apoptosis: The Role of Chrysin.
supplements.summary: Chrysin reduced oxidative stress and liver cell death caused by bendiocarb exposure in rats.

supplements.title: Tomatidine is a senotherapeutic compound that improves cognitive function and reduces cellular senescence in aged mice.
supplements.summary: Tomatidine, a tomato compound, reduces cellular aging markers and improves cognitive function and movement in aged mice.

supplements.title: Combining 5-ALA-PDT with berbamine as an in vitro multimodal therapy approach against bladder cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Combining light therapy with a plant compound called berbamine effectively kills bladder cancer cells, including drug-resistant variants.

supplements.title: Urolithin A blocks colorectal cancer progression by AKT1 inhibition-driven immune activation.
supplements.summary: Urolithin A, a natural compound, slows colorectal cancer growth by blocking AKT1 protein and activating immune cells.

supplements.title: Unlocking the potential of marine natural product fragments for rational anticancer drug design: a computational approach.
supplements.summary: Researchers created a library of marine-derived molecular fragments to computationally design new cancer drugs targeting immune evasion proteins.

supplements.title: Frontiers in Gut Health: The Emerging Role of Berries in Microbiota Modulation and Gastrointestinal Diseases.
supplements.summary: Berries may reduce gastrointestinal cancer risk and improve gut health by modifying beneficial bacteria and reducing intestinal inflammation.

supplements.title: Effectiveness of green tea (Camellia sinensis) based mouth rinse on oral health status, pain and quality of life among advanced head and neck cancer patients in a tertiary care centre-a randomized controlled trial.
supplements.summary: Green tea mouth rinse improved oral health, reduced pain, and enhanced quality of life in advanced head and neck cancer patients.

supplements.title: Icaritin Disrupts Cholesterol Biosynthesis and Induce Cell Death in Pancreatic Carcinoma: A Transcriptomic and Lipidomic Analysis.
supplements.summary: Icaritin stops pancreatic cancer cells from making cholesterol, causing them to die.

supplements.title: Spirocyclic β-lactone secondary metabolites modulate spliceosome function.
supplements.summary: Researchers discovered that spirocyclic β-lactones, natural compounds from bacteria, kill cancer cells by targeting and disrupting the spliceosome, a cellular machine that processes genes.

off_label.title: Rapid screening of potent and mechanistically insightful repurposable anticancer drugs targeting EGFR for non-small cell lung cancer: machine learning-aided and structure-guided approach.
off_label.summary: Researchers used machine learning to identify two existing drugs, idarubicin and larotrectinib, as potential treatments for EGFR-resistant lung cancer.

off_label.title: Anticancer Efficacy of HPPH-PDT Synergies with BCG-Immunotherapy or COX-2 Inhibitor in Treating Bladder Cancer.
off_label.summary: HPPH-PDT combined with COX-2 inhibitors or BCG immunotherapy significantly improves bladder cancer cure rates in mice.

off_label.title: Aspirin and other nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) for preventing colorectal cancer and colorectal adenoma in the general population.
off_label.summary: Aspirin and NSAIDs may help prevent colorectal cancer, but evidence remains unclear on whether benefits outweigh potential harms.

off_label.title: Tenofovir Alafenamide Promotes Differentiation and Induces Apoptosis of AML Cells by Inhibiting Telomerase Reverse Transcriptase.
off_label.summary: Tenofovir Alafenamide shows promise against acute myeloid leukemia by blocking telomerase and triggering cancer cell death and differentiation.

off_label.title: Effect of metformin on pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors of multiple endocrine neoplasia type 1.
off_label.summary: Metformin did not prevent or slow pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors in MEN1 syndrome patients or mouse models.

off_label.title: The Effects of Apilarnil and Imatinib on GR/GST/TrxR1 Enzyme Activities and Pentose Phosphate Pathway Enzymes in Rats.
off_label.summary: Apilarnil, a bee product, restored antioxidant enzyme activity suppressed by imatinib cancer drug in rats, potentially reducing toxicity.

off_label.title: Metformin triggers apoptosis via endoplasmic reticulum stress in HER2-positive breast cancer cell lines.
off_label.summary: Metformin kills HER2-positive breast cancer cells by triggering stress responses that cause programmed cell death in a dose-dependent manner.

off_label.title: Current Advances in Paraptosis Inducer Development and Mechanistic Understanding for Anticancer Applications.
off_label.summary: Researchers are developing paraptosis inducers—natural and synthetic compounds—as a promising new way to kill cancer cells through a distinct cell death mechanism.

off_label.title: Chronic complication risk and benefits of fenofibrate in type 2 diabetes by a PPARα polymorphism (rs6008845, C/T): a FIELD trial substudy.
off_label.summary: A genetic variant in PPARα affects how well the drug fenofibrate prevents diabetes complications in different patients.

off_label.title: Neuroprotective Effect of Memantine and Rosuvastatin Against Oxaliplatin Induced Peripheral Neuropathy in Patients With Colorectal Cancer
off_label.summary: Memantine and rosuvastatin may protect colorectal cancer patients from nerve damage caused by oxaliplatin chemotherapy.

off_label.title: Phosphodiesterase 5 Inhibitor Sildenafil Inhibits HPV+ Cervical Cancer Cells and Cervical Cancer Stem Cells by Apoptotic Induction and Telomerase Activity Modulation.
off_label.summary: Sildenafil, a common erectile dysfunction drug, kills HPV-positive cervical cancer cells and cancer stem cells by triggering cell death.

off_label.title: ALDH1A1 is a potential novel target for treatment of ADPKD.
off_label.summary: Researchers found that blocking ALDH1A1 protein with disulfiram drug slows cyst growth in polycystic kidney disease mice.

off_label.title: The Effect of Losartan in Preventing Paclitaxel-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy in Breast Cancer: A Randomized, Controlled Study.
off_label.summary: Losartan may help prevent nerve damage caused by paclitaxel chemotherapy in breast cancer patients.

off_label.title: Preventing First and Further Decompensation in Advanced Chronic Liver Disease.
off_label.summary: Carvedilol and combined therapies effectively prevent liver decompensation in advanced chronic liver disease across disease stages.

off_label.title: Topical Imiquimod for Oral Cavity Leukoplakia and Dysplasia: A Scoping Review.
off_label.summary: Imiquimod, an FDA-approved skin treatment, shows promise for treating precancerous mouth lesions when applied topically.

biomarkers.title: CA72-4 derived from synovial cells inhibits monosodium urate-induced macrophage M1 polarization by activating the TIGIT/SHP-1 axis through binding to Siglec-15.
biomarkers.summary: CA72-4 protein from synovial cells reduces harmful inflammation in gout by activating a specific immune signaling pathway in macrophages.

biomarkers.title: The 15-year bibliometric landscape of glioblastoma vaccines: Emergence of combinatorial immunotherapy.
biomarkers.summary: Glioblastoma vaccine research has shifted toward combination immunotherapies that tackle tumor immunosuppression rather than single-agent approaches.

biomarkers.title: Upper tract urothelial carcinoma associated with Lynch syndrome.
biomarkers.summary: Lynch syndrome significantly increases risk of upper tract urothelial cancer, requiring specific screening and management strategies.

biomarkers.title: Mining cancer genomes for copy number alterations identifies glycosylation enzymes as oncogenic drivers.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified B4GALT5, a glycosylation enzyme, as an oncogene that drives cancer growth through integrin-Src signaling and can be therapeutically targeted.

biomarkers.title: Tissue-specific inflammation induces cell state plasticity with oncogenic addiction in mucosal melanoma.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking HER2/3 proteins in mucosal melanoma overcomes chemoresistance by reversing inflammation-driven cancer cell plasticity.

biomarkers.title: An effective tumor-inhibiting siRNA delivery platform.
biomarkers.summary: HK peptide delivery system reduced triple-negative breast cancer tumors by up to 82% through targeted siRNA therapy in mice.

biomarkers.title: Micro-/nanorobots in nanomedicine - Guidance, imaging and the integration of AI and robotics.
biomarkers.summary: Tiny magnetic robots guided by AI could deliver drugs directly to tumors and destroy cancer cells using heat and targeted therapy.

biomarkers.title: CD8 TRM-like T cells expressing perforin and IFN-γ define a pediatric activated T-cell acute liver failure endotype.
biomarkers.summary: Pediatric acute liver failure involves CD8 T cells with tissue-resident markers; identifying this immune signature may guide targeted T-cell therapies.

biomarkers.title: Risk-stratified surveillance for hepatocellular carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Tailoring hepatocellular carcinoma surveillance intensity to individual patient risk may improve detection while reducing unnecessary testing and false positives.

biomarkers.title: Discovery and Validation of Lung Cancer Biomarkers Based on Proteomic Analysis of Bronchoalveolar Lavage Fluid from the Self-Controlled Pulmonary Lobes.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified two new lung cancer biomarkers in fluid from cancerous lung lobes, enabling better distinction of suspicious nodules from benign growths.

biomarkers.title: Spatial and functional polarization of cancer-associated fibroblasts with CXCR4-mediated immune modulation in hepatocellular carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified how different types of cancer-supporting cells in liver tumors are spatially organized and influence immune responses through a specific pathway.

biomarkers.title: Optimization of Covalent 6-Cyanoquinazoline KRASG12C Inhibitors for the Treatment of Solid Tumors.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a new oral drug targeting KRASG12C mutations in solid tumors, showing promise in lung cancer models.

biomarkers.title: A Conversational Platform (Okaya) for Multimodal Digital Biomarkers of Fatigue, Cognition, and Mental Health: Feasibility Observational Study.
biomarkers.summary: A conversational platform successfully collected digital biomarkers from voice, video, and text to monitor fatigue, cognition, and mental health.

biomarkers.title: RET receptor tyrosine kinase architecture, assemblies and activation.
biomarkers.summary: RET receptor's unique structure with cadherin-like domains flexibly binds ligands to activate cancer-driving signaling pathways.

biomarkers.title: Breast Cancer Metastasis in Obesity: Extracellular Vesicles as Drivers.
biomarkers.summary: Obesity-derived extracellular vesicles promote breast cancer spread through TGF-β signaling and fatty acid fueling.

trials.title: A population-based legacy study of myasthenia gravis in Iceland: insights from a small Arctic nation.
trials.summary: Icelandic study finds myasthenia gravis affects 9 per 100,000 people, with women typically affected earlier than men.

trials.title: The 15-year bibliometric landscape of glioblastoma vaccines: Emergence of combinatorial immunotherapy.
trials.summary: Glioblastoma vaccine research has shifted toward combination immunotherapies that tackle tumor immunosuppression rather than single-agent approaches.

trials.title: Upper tract urothelial carcinoma associated with Lynch syndrome.
trials.summary: Lynch syndrome significantly increases risk of upper tract urothelial cancer, requiring specific screening and management strategies.

trials.title: Tissue-specific inflammation induces cell state plasticity with oncogenic addiction in mucosal melanoma.
trials.summary: Blocking HER2/3 proteins in mucosal melanoma overcomes chemoresistance by reversing inflammation-driven cancer cell plasticity.

trials.title: The safety, reactogenicity, and immunogenicity of the self-amplifying mRNA COVID-19 vaccine GRT-R910 as a booster in healthy adults.
trials.summary: A new COVID-19 booster vaccine candidate showed safe immune responses in early human testing.

trials.title: An effective tumor-inhibiting siRNA delivery platform.
trials.summary: HK peptide delivery system reduced triple-negative breast cancer tumors by up to 82% through targeted siRNA therapy in mice.

trials.title: Micro-/nanorobots in nanomedicine - Guidance, imaging and the integration of AI and robotics.
trials.summary: Tiny magnetic robots guided by AI could deliver drugs directly to tumors and destroy cancer cells using heat and targeted therapy.

trials.summary: Pediatric acute liver failure involves CD8 T cells with tissue-resident markers; identifying this immune signature may guide targeted T-cell therapies.

trials.title: Risk-stratified surveillance for hepatocellular carcinoma.
trials.summary: Tailoring hepatocellular carcinoma surveillance intensity to individual patient risk may improve detection while reducing unnecessary testing and false positives.

trials.title: Optimization of Covalent 6-Cyanoquinazoline KRASG12C Inhibitors for the Treatment of Solid Tumors.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a new oral drug targeting KRASG12C mutations in solid tumors, showing promise in lung cancer models.

trials.title: A Conversational Platform (Okaya) for Multimodal Digital Biomarkers of Fatigue, Cognition, and Mental Health: Feasibility Observational Study.
trials.summary: A conversational platform successfully collected digital biomarkers from voice, video, and text to monitor fatigue, cognition, and mental health.

trials.title: Feasibility of online adaptive SBRT boost with 1.5-T MR-Linac for cervical cancer patients unsuitable for brachytherapy: a planning study.
trials.summary: MR-guided adaptive radiotherapy improves tumor coverage and reduces organ damage in cervical cancer patients unable to receive standard brachytherapy.

trials.title: Resilient nanostructured bioanalytic microneedle longitudinally monitors preclinical renal and hepatic drug clearance and dysfunction.
trials.summary: Wearable microneedles with improved sensors successfully monitored drug clearance and detected liver and kidney dysfunction in real-time during animal studies.

trials.title: Uncovering BAP1 deubiquitination landscape enhances mechanism elucidation and therapeutic precision for BAP1-deficient pancancers.
trials.summary: Researchers identified that blocking LSD1 and PARP1 together effectively kills multiple BAP1-mutant cancers by disrupting DNA repair mechanisms.

trials.title: Irreversible Electroporation Enhances Solid Tumor Infiltration and Selective Cancer Cell Lysis by CAR T Cells.
trials.summary: Electroporation helps CAR T cells penetrate and destroy solid tumors better than radiation alone, without harming the T cells themselves.

mind_body.title: Effectiveness and Safety of Acupuncture for Cancer-Related Cognitive Impairment: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
mind_body.summary: Acupuncture may help improve thinking and memory problems caused by cancer and its treatments, though more rigorous research is needed.

mind_body.title: Music therapy interventions on symptom management in adults with advanced cancer - multisession longitudinal impact: systematic review.
mind_body.summary: Music therapy sessions may help reduce symptoms and improve quality of life in adults with advanced cancer receiving end-of-life care.

mind_body.title: Consensus Recommendations for Disease- and Treatment-Related Fatigue in Patients With Advanced Prostate Cancer: A Modified Delphi Panel.
mind_body.summary: Experts created guidelines to help doctors and advanced prostate cancer patients manage fatigue together through shared decision-making.

mind_body.title: Application of Affective Touch in Patients With Advanced Cancer: Effects on Existential Distress, Pain, and Quality of Life.
mind_body.summary: Affective touch, a gentle hands-on therapy, reduced existential distress, pain, and improved quality of life in advanced cancer patients.

mind_body.title: Effectiveness of Mindfulness-Based Art Therapy for Oncology Nurses: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
mind_body.summary: Mindfulness-based art therapy reduces psychological stress in oncology nurses, improving their wellbeing and patient care quality.

mind_body.title: Acupoint catgut embedding ameliorates laparotomy-induced cognitive decline in aged mice by restoring gut microbiota.
mind_body.summary: Acupoint catgut embedding treatment reduced post-surgery cognitive decline in elderly mice by restoring healthy gut bacteria.

mind_body.title: Effects of manual acupuncture on microglial polarization and the Sirt1/NF-κB pathway in a rat model of post-stroke depression.
mind_body.summary: Acupuncture may treat post-stroke depression by reducing brain inflammation through immune cell regulation.

mind_body.title: Optimizing Postoperative Analgesia After Perianal Abscess Surgery Using Ultrasound-Guided Pudendal Nerve Block Combined with Wrist-Ankle Acupuncture: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
mind_body.summary: Ultrasound-guided nerve blocks combined with acupuncture effectively reduced pain after perianal abscess surgery compared to standard treatment alone.

mind_body.title: Developing and Evaluating an Inpatient Caregiver Support Program: Feasibility, Acceptability, and Perceived Impact.
mind_body.summary: A hospital program providing emotional support and guidance to family caregivers of seriously ill patients proved feasible, acceptable, and beneficial.

mind_body.title: Dual-Target SPG-Mandibular Neuromodulation for Post-Radiation Painful Trigeminal Neuropathy: A 7-Year Follow-up.
mind_body.summary: A 7-year study shows nerve stimulation effectively reduces chronic facial pain caused by radiation damage.

mind_body.title: Music in the Last Hours: Finding Humanity in the ICU.
mind_body.summary: Personalized music played at a cancer patient's bedside in the ICU reduced distress and provided comfort during final hours of life.

mind_body.title: Intolerance of uncertainty and attitudes toward cancer as predictors of spiritual well-being in patients with cancer.
mind_body.summary: Cancer patients' spiritual well-being is predicted by their tolerance of uncertainty and their attitudes toward their cancer diagnosis.

mind_body.title: Implementing video-based group music therapy during cancer treatment: insights from a mixed-methods study.
mind_body.summary: Video-based group music therapy helps cancer patients participate in beneficial therapy sessions despite treatment-related physical limitations.

mind_body.title: Mapping global research trends of Tai Chi for sleep health: Scientometric insights and network-based perspectives.
mind_body.summary: Tai Chi, a gentle mind-body exercise, shows promise as a safe alternative treatment for improving sleep quality and addressing sleep disorders.

mind_body.title: Exploring the Safety, Acceptability, and Efficacy of Psilocybin Among Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Patients With Major Depressive Disorder: A Proof-of-Concept Trial (DREAM LUNG STUDY)
mind_body.summary: A trial tests psilocybin combined with therapy to treat depression in non-small cell lung cancer patients.
